evals.prompt: I need to pass my PostgreSQL password to Spice without hardcoding it in spicepod.yaml. I'm using a .env file. How do I set this up?
evals.expected_output: Configure env secret store, reference with ${ env:PG_PASSWORD } syntax, explain .env file loading

assertions.name: shows_env_store
assertions.description: Should configure the env secret store

assertions.name: shows_reference_syntax
assertions.description: Should show the secret reference syntax

evals.prompt: We're running Spice in Kubernetes. How do I reference K8s secrets in my spicepod.yaml?
evals.expected_output: Configure kubernetes secret store with secret name, reference keys with ${ k8s:KEY }

assertions.name: shows_kubernetes_store
assertions.description: Should configure a Kubernetes secret store

evals.prompt: I have secrets in both AWS Secrets Manager and environment variables. How do I use both and control which one takes priority?
evals.expected_output: Configure both stores, explain precedence order (last defined wins), show ${ secrets:KEY } to search all stores

assertions.name: shows_generic_reference
assertions.description: Should show the generic secrets: reference that searches all stores
